name: archinest/menu-organizer-collapsible-admin-menu
description: Groups WordPress admin menu items into named, collapsible categories.

scripts-descriptions.lint: Check the codebase against WordPress Coding Standards. Note that the bundled PHPCompatibility 9.3.5 predates PHP 8 and cannot detect PHP 8 syntax; the binding 7.4 check is the syntax-php74 CI job.
scripts-descriptions.lint:fix: Auto-fix the coding standard violations that can be fixed safely.
scripts-descriptions.lint:report: Print a per-file summary of coding standard violations.
scripts-descriptions.check:readme: Validate readme.txt against the WordPress.org readme standard.
scripts-descriptions.test: Alias of test:unit, the suite that runs anywhere.
scripts-descriptions.test:unit: Run the WordPress-independent tests. Needs no database.
scripts-descriptions.test:integration: Run the tests that need WordPress and a database. Set WP_TESTS_DIR first.
